Make calc/core.py precision-safe for decimal.Decimal. Requirements: add, subtract, multiply, divide and any other arithmetic there must accept int, float and Decimal in any combination. If either operand is a Decimal, the result must be a Decimal computed without binary-float rounding error (converting a float operand via str() or Decimal(repr(x)) is acceptable; Decimal(float) directly is not). If neither operand is a Decimal, behaviour and return types must be exactly as before (ints stay ints, floats stay floats). The divide-by-zero message must stay the same for Decimal zero too. Think about the subtle cases before coding, add tests in tests/test_core.py covering mixed inputs, and keep the whole suite passing with: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
